description: This file defines a CKEditor plugin dialog for inserting smiley images, including event handlers for user interactions and HTML generation for the smiley selection interface.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles click events on smiley images, inserting the selected smiley into the editor.

methods.name: onKeydown
methods.description: Handles keyboard navigation within the smiley dialog, enabling arrow key and tab navigation.
